entities.summary: Engelbrecht "Brecht" Rodenburg is a retired volleyball player from the Netherlands, who represented his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta. There he won the gold medal with the Dutch Men's National Team by defeating archrivals Italy in the final (3–2).
